tickets.title: Coordinate custodian security case escalation and temporary online restrictions
tickets.text: Support Helena Lanternmoss on a call with Velvet Acorn Custody to address temporary online restrictions and the fraud review process following the security incident.
tickets.evidence: She requested Apricot Compass Advisory support on a call with Velvet Acorn Custody to address temporary online restrictions and the fraud review process; the agreed follow-up is due November 8, 2023.

tickets.title: Investigate unauthorized trial credits and pending external bank link
tickets.text: Investigate the source of the two small trial credits labeled Buttonwood Balloon Payments and the pending external bank link in the joint taxable account activity screen. Determine any reversal requirements for the unauthorized activity.
tickets.evidence: The source and any reversal requirements remain unresolved, with follow-up needed by November 10, 2023.

tickets.title: Gather custodian security review evidence packet
tickets.text: Obtain the full alert emails, screenshots of the recovery phone notice, and the latest Velvet Acorn Custody message center note for the custodian security file.
tickets.evidence: the full alert emails, screenshots of the recovery phone notice, and the latest Velvet Acorn Custody message center note were not yet available to Apricot Compass Advisory for the custodian security file; the agreed follow-up is due November 9, 2023.

tickets.title: Complete household profile update
tickets.text: Refresh the household profile using client-provided updates and recent planning notes. Confirm household members, contact preferences, employment status, dependents, trusted contacts, insurance context, estate document status, and any major life changes that may affect planning recommendations. Reflect Ruth Lanternmoss’s move into the household in October 2023 and Iris Lanternmoss’s successor fiduciary role, and review the contact hierarchy and Helena’s prior work phone number.

subTasks.title: Collect profile change information
subTasks.text: Request or compile updates for household members, addresses, contact preferences, employment, dependents, and major recent or expected life events.

subTasks.title: Update planning assumptions
subTasks.text: Revise income, savings, spending, retirement timing, education funding, and family support assumptions in the planning record as applicable.

subTasks.title: Identify advice impacts
subTasks.text: Flag changes that may affect tax planning, risk management, estate coordination, cash flow, or investment allocation recommendations.

subTasks.title: Confirm profile completion
subTasks.text: Review the updated profile for consistency and note any remaining open questions for the next client conversation.

tickets.evidence: the profile review showed Oliver as the only trusted contact and included Helena’s prior work phone number; Ruth’s move into the household and Iris’s successor fiduciary role may affect the contact hierarchy and planning record. The agreed follow-up is due November 17, 2023.

tickets.title: Review custodial multifactor authentication and device safeguards
tickets.text: Review the custodial profile’s authentication and device safeguards for Helena Lanternmoss, Oliver Lanternmoss, and advisor-view permissions. Address the missing app-based authentication and the profile’s continued reference to SMS authentication.
tickets.evidence: Mira observed that the custodial profile notes still referenced SMS authentication and did not show app-based authentication for Helena’s login, Oliver’s login, or advisor-view permissions; the agreed follow-up is due November 14, 2023.

tickets.title: Follow up on policy renewal details
tickets.text: Contact the client or insurance professional to confirm renewal status, premium change, coverage changes, beneficiary updates needed, and any action required before the renewal window closes. Record received documents and route planning questions to the advisor. Compare Pocket Lantern Insurance’s identity theft endorsement coverage and reimbursement cap with Helena Lanternmoss’s expectations.
tickets.evidence: the Pocket Lantern Insurance renewal materials describe an identity theft endorsement with a reimbursement cap below Helena’s expectation, and the coverage choice remains unresolved while the account security issue is being reviewed, with follow-up needed by November 22, 2023.
